about_the_game:
Unnatural Selection Adventures for Shadowdark RPG


Three one-shot adventures, complete with maps, descriptions, and cover art.

Nest of the Entomancer
A series of strange, insect-like tracks leads to rumors of a hidden menace beneath the earth. The quest draws adventurers into tunnels and chambers where the natural and unnatural blur together, with dangers lurking behind every mound and shadow.

Temptation of Dominus
Disappearance, dread, and a newly unearthed crypt draw the brave into a place of ancient power. Within lies the lure of promises too great to ignore, and the test of whether heroes will remain themselves or be swayed by darker forces.

The Felwood Curse
Travelers whisper of a haunted forest where the trees glow, animals speak, and legends of a fallen champion persist. Those who enter must face both the mysteries of the land and the lingering curse that binds its heart.

Nest of the Entomancer - Levels 1-3
Temptation of Dominus - Levels 3-5
The Felwood Curse - Levels 5-7

Adapted for Fantasy Grounds by: Kevin Heffernan

Requires: An active subscription or a one time purchase of a Fantasy Grounds license and the Shadowdark RPG ruleset.

Screenshots may differ from what you see in-game based on the extension and ruleset you have loaded.
